item.title: Allied Services janitorial departments earn prestigious certification
item.description: Allied Services Integrated Health System announced that its janitorial departments within the Vocational Services Division have once again achieved the Cleaning Industry Management Standard – Green Building (CIMS-GB) with Honors certification, awarded by ISSA, the worldwide cleaning industry association. item.title: Parmy Olson: The AI panic ignores something important — the evidence
item.description: Last week, a post written by tech entrepreneur and investor Matt Shumer went viral on social media. Titled “Something Big Is Happening,” it was a rundown of all the ways artificial intelligence would, in short order, decimate professional jobs.

item.title: Lackawanna County communities told to address data centers on their own
item.description: Towns in the Abingtons and Dunmore and Scranton agreed to share land uses as part of a zoning collective. But the collective's plan doesn't address data centers and will take years to update.

item.title: NEPA HALL OF FAME: Holeva, Davies to be honored
item.description: Veteran journalist Larry Holeva and public address announcer John Davies are being honored by the Northeast Chapter of the Pennsylvania Hall of Fame. Holeva is the recipient of the John McCormick Media Award, which Davies is being given the Thomas “Doc” Dougherty Service Award. This is the first year the Hall of Fame has named the awards. item.title: D2 GIRLS WRESTLING: SanClementi breaks through for gold
item.description: PLAINS TWP. — The District 2 wrestling championships were in the second round of finals matches with the Class 2A and 3A boys 114-pound bouts and 106-pound girls match happening simultaneously. All of a sudden, fans roared from the bleachers next to the girls final, where Wallenpaupack’s Rosa SanClementi hit a seven-point move on two-time defending champion Western Wayne’s Mia Gifford before the first-period buzzer.
